title: Free Energy
author: Unknown
description: A compilation on 'free energy' technology built around The Manual of Free Energy Devices and Systems by D. A. Kelly (Volume II), together with related papers. It surveys unconventional energy devices and their inventors, including the Searl effect generator of British inventor John Searl, the Wanlass motor, Bruce DePalma's 'N machine' homopolar generator, Viktor Schauberger's implosion and 'flying saucer' models, Paul Brown's nuclear-battery work, magnetic motors, M-L converters and other over-unity or ambient-energy concepts, with diagrams and descriptions of operating principles. It also includes theoretical material proposing that space contains vast unaccounted energy (with reference to the cosmic background radiation and missing mass). These devices and claims lie outside accepted physics; the collection is a document of the alternative-energy and fringe-science subculture.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
